title: Eurostat sdg_11_52: Premature deaths due to exposure to PM2.5, Italy (annual, JSON-stat)
summary: Annual national count and rate of premature deaths attributed to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure for Italy only (geo=IT), served as a JSON-stat 2.0 response from the Eurostat dissemination API. The response holds 36 cells (2 units x 18 years) with no missing cells reported, and the table was last updated 2025-12-09 per the response header. It is national, annual context only: it has no hourly, district, traffic, weather or clinic data, and it does not cover the 2024-2025 production window.

quality_notes: Year 2006 is absent from the time dimension (2005 then 2007). Confirmed in both inspect_dataset_link and summarize_jsonstat outputs. Gap is not explained by any documentation read.
Coverage ends 2023, while the production window is 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31. N6 cannot be met for production from this source.
Prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) overlaps only 2005, and only if an annual value is acceptable there.
Unit dimension has two values (NR: Number, RT: Rate). The rate's denominator is not stated in the summary.

No missing-value sentinel (-200, -999 or similar) documented in what was read. Only the summary's missing_cells=0 was available; cell values were not sampled, so sentinel absence is not verified at value level.
Only the JSON-stat summary was read. Full data values and the Eurostat metadata/notes page were not retrieved (no further calls made).
